latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — easily generate 1080p AI videos from text or image prompts with local/cloud hybrid workflow.

- Turn text descriptions or uploaded clips into high-quality videos (MP4, MOV, and more) in about 1–3 minutes.
- Automated setup: Anonymous token handled on first use, with simple connection steps.
- No manual timeline or export settings required — just describe what you want.
- Supports uploads, background music, aspect ratio changes, text overlays, and more via conversational prompts.
- Clear API-based workflow for uploading, editing, previewing, exporting, and credit checks.
- Handles error cases (token, session, file type/size, credits, rate limits) and provides user-friendly feedback.
